title: Student Lesson Report – Attendance – Authorized teacher updates Student A – Persists after reload
description: AC 03.1 — State Transition / CRUD-readback — An authorized teacher changes Student A's attendance through the report workflow and reads the saved value after reload.
preconditions:
- Teacher Taro is logged in to Salesforce with permission to update attendance from the Student Lesson Report.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 01 in the current academic year.
- Student Session SS-A01 has Attendance Status Present and no Absent Reason before the update.
steps_actions:
1. Teacher Taro opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.
2. Teacher Taro changes Student A's Attendance Status to Absent and enters Absent Reason Medical appointment.
3. Teacher Taro saves the attendance update.
4. Teacher Taro reloads Student A's Student Lesson Report.
steps_result:
1. The report shows Student A's Lesson Tokyo 01 row and the available attendance-update control.
2. The attendance-update control accepts the specified values.
3. Salesforce confirms the save without creating an additional Student Session.
4. The Lesson Tokyo 01 row shows Attendance Status Absent and Absent Reason Medical appointment.
steps_data:
1. Student Session = SS-A01; Initial status = Present
2. New status = Absent; Absent Reason = Medical appointment
3. Student Session = SS-A01
4. Expected persisted values = Absent / Medical appointment
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Attendance – User without edit permission – Keeps attendance unchanged
description: AC 03.1 — Permission Matrix / Negative — A user without attendance-edit permission cannot change Student A's stored attendance.
preconditions:
- User C is logged in to Salesforce without attendance-edit permission.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 01 in the current academic year.
- Student Session SS-A01 has Attendance Status Present and no Absent Reason.
steps_actions: 1. User C opens Student A's Student Lesson Report.\n2. User C attempts to change Student A's Attendance Status to Absent.\n3. User C reloads the report.
steps_result: 1. The report shows the existing attendance values without granting an editable attendance control.\n2. Salesforce blocks the change or does not offer a way to save it.\n3. The Lesson Tokyo 01 row still shows Attendance Status Present with no Absent Reason.
steps_data: 1. Student Session = SS-A01; Status = Present\n2. Attempted status = Absent\n3. Expected unchanged values = Present / blank
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Attendance – Update Student A – Leaves Student B unchanged
description: AC 03.1 — CRUD-readback / Regression — Updating one report row changes only the selected Student Session.
preconditions:
- Teacher Taro is logged in to Salesforce with permission to update attendance from the Student Lesson Report.
- Student A and Student B each have a current-academic-year session in Lesson Tokyo 01.
- Student Session SS-A01 has Attendance Status Present.
- Student Session SS-B01 has Attendance Status Late and Absent Reason blank.
steps_actions: 1. Teacher Taro opens the Student Lesson Report containing Student A and Student B rows.\n2. Teacher Taro changes Student A's Attendance Status to Absent and saves the update.\n3. Teacher Taro reloads the report and reads Student B's row.
steps_result: 1. The report shows both students with their prepared attendance values.\n2. Salesforce saves the update for Student Session SS-A01.\n3. Student B remains Late with an empty Absent Reason.
steps_data: 1. Student A = Present; Student B = Late\n2. SS-A01 → Absent\n3. SS-B01 = Late / blank
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object

title: Student Lesson Report – Attendance – Save retry – Retains one intended attendance value
description: AC 03.1 — Data Integrity / Regression — Retrying the same attendance save leaves one final intended value for the selected Student Session.
preconditions:
- Teacher Taro is logged in to Salesforce with permission to update attendance from the Student Lesson Report.
- Student A has Lesson Tokyo 01 in the current academic year.
- Student Session SS-A01 has Attendance Status Present and no Absent Reason.
steps_actions: 1. Teacher Taro opens Student A's Student Lesson Report and changes SS-A01 to Absent with Absent Reason Medical appointment.\n2. Teacher Taro saves the attendance update and repeats the same save after the first save response.\n3. Teacher Taro reloads the report and opens SS-A01.
steps_result: 1. The report shows the pending attendance values for Student A.\n2. Salesforce retains one intended attendance value for SS-A01 and does not create a second Student Session.\n3. Both the report row and SS-A01 detail show Attendance Status Absent and Absent Reason Medical appointment.
steps_data: 1. SS-A01 → Absent / Medical appointment\n2. Retry payload = Absent / Medical appointment\n3. Expected final values = Absent / Medical appointment
suite: EEA | Core | Student's Lesson Report or Lesson Classroom info in Lesson object
